description: Source file implementing utility functions for oneDNN integration within ATen, including tensor format and dtype handling, broadcasting, and convolution format helpers.

methods.name: make_onednn_memory
methods.description: Creates a oneDNN memory object with specified descriptor, engine, and optional pointer.

methods.name: get_dnnl_default_format
methods.description: Returns default memory format tag based on tensor dimensions, channels last flag, and allowance for undefined formats.

methods.name: get_onednn_dtype
methods.description: Determines the appropriate oneDNN data type for a given tensor based on its scalar type.

methods.name: get_onednn_dtype_include_double
methods.description: Returns the data type including support for double precision tensors.

methods.name: is_supported_onednn_dtype
methods.description: Checks if the tensor's dtype is supported by oneDNN.

methods.name: get_onednn_dims
methods.description: Extracts the dimensions of a tensor as a DNNL dims object.

methods.name: get_onednn_strides
methods.description: Extracts the strides of a tensor as a DNNL dims object.

methods.name: get_onednn_md
methods.description: Constructs a DNNL memory descriptor from a tensor.

methods.name: onednn_strides_check
methods.description: Checks if tensor strides are compatible with oneDNN expectations.

methods.name: is_broadcast
methods.description: Determines if a tensor is broadcasted (has stride 0).

methods.name: undo_broadcast_on_batch
methods.description: Removes broadcast semantics from batch dimensions of two tensors.

methods.name: undo_broadcast
methods.description: Converts a broadcasted tensor to a shape with stride 1 for broadcasted dims.

methods.name: is_onednn_matmul_strides
methods.description: Checks if tensor strides are suitable for oneDNN matrix multiplication.

methods.name: get_cl_tag_by_ndim
methods.description: Returns the appropriate memory format for given tensor dimension.

methods.name: binary_valid
methods.description: Validates if two tensors can be used together in a binary operation with oneDNN.

methods.name: use_channels_last_for_conv
methods.description: Determines if channels last format should be used for convolution.

methods.name: conv_src_fmt
methods.description: Returns the source format tag for convolution based on dimension and channels last flag.

methods.name: compatible_weight_dims
methods.description: Calculates compatible weight dimensions for convolution based on parameters.

methods.name: conv_weight_fmt
methods.description: Returns the format tag for convolution weights based on dimension, grouping, and channels last.

methods.name: apply_tf32_if_allowed
methods.description: Sets TF32 math mode in oneDNN primitives if allowed by global context.
